publicPages.author: Author
publicPages.aboutBody: Trustwork is an industry publication and community with tools for procurement, sales and project work. The public sections and a demo workspace are open now; commercial deals and real company data are not connected yet.
publicPages.helpBody: The support channel opens with the public launch. Until then the development team answers product questions.
publicPages.legalBody: The terms of use and the privacy policy will be published before the service launches. Signing up in the demo creates no account and accepts no terms.
publicPages.statusLine: User-facing features are still being built.
